purpose: Copy into private data; fill with legal user-provided tracks. Do not commit paths, audio or annotations.
annotationRules: Add onsetsSec, beatsSec, downbeatsSec arrays only after listening and labeling. Missing means not reviewed; an empty array means reviewed and no events.
Times are absolute seconds from canonical playback zero, not relative clip positions.
Lighting accents must be reviewed separately; they are not all onsets.
Assign at least three tracks held-out before tuning. Do not tune on held-out labels.
